# HistogramChart

## Overview

`HistogramChart` is the top-level orchestration wrapper for histogram visualisations. It composes:

- **ChartHeader** — title and subtitle
- **ChartLegend** — categorical colour key
- **DataDisplay** — KPI block (optional, static or hover-driven)
- **HistogramGroup** — flexible-width bars, Y-axis, X-axis, AvgLine, HoverBadge
- **ChartFooter** — source and annotation text

All visual values come from the CSS cascade — no hard-coded pixels, colours, or font sizes. Brand, theme, platform, and density tokens are injected at `@layer brand` by `generateDataVisCSS` (DataVis palette) and `useBrandCSSNew` (surface/typography). There is no `modes` prop.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `233:31161`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **URL**: `https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=233-31161`

## Architecture

```
HistogramChart
├── ChartAccessibility (wrapper — role="figure", aria-live region, hidden data table)
│   └── histogramChart (container — CSS module, width/height from props)
│       ├── ChartHeader (optional — chartHeader boolean)
│       │   ├── ChartTitle
│       │   └── ChartSubtitle
│       ├── ChartLegend (optional — chartLegend boolean)
│       │   └── ChartKey[]
│       ├── DataDisplay (optional — dataDisplay boolean)
│       │   ├── mainLabel
│       │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
│       │   └── Badge (BadgeConfig)
│       ├── histogramGroupWrapper (flex: 1 — fills remaining height)
│       │   └── HistogramGroup
│       │       ├── YAxis (optional)
│       │       ├── barWrapper
│       │       │   └── verticalBar[] (flex: 1 fill; barPositive + barNegative
│       │       │                       split, auto, when data has negatives)
│       │       ├── xAxis ticks (optional)
│       │       ├── ZeroLine (auto, only when data has negatives)
│       │       ├── AvgLine (optional)
│       │       └── HoverBadge (optional)
│       └── ChartFooter (optional — chartFooter boolean)
│           ├── annotationLeft
│           └── annotationRight
```

## Token Pipeline

```
Convex → generateDataVisCSS → useStyleInjection → @layer brand
                                                    → --DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{1..12}
useBrandCSSNew → @layer brand
                 → --Surface-* --Text-* --Spacing-* --Typography-*
```

Bar colours: `catColor(n)` returns `"var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-${n})"` — resolved in the browser at render time. No JS hex resolution.

Section gap: `var(--HistogramChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))` — consumer-overridable, default from `--Spacing-5`.

## Import

```tsx
import { HistogramChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Format

```typescript
import type { ChartDataPoint } from '@oneui/datavis';

const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: '0–10', value: 5 },
  { category: '10–20', value: 12 },
  { category: '20–30', value: 25 },
  { category: '30–40', value: 45 },
];
```

Negative values are supported out of the box — no extra prop. `HistogramGroup` auto-detects negative values from `data` (same as `VerticalBarChart`/`VerticalBarGroup`) and renders bars above/below a zero line accordingly. See **HistogramGroup.md → Negative Values** for the full rendering model.

```typescript
const netChangeData: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: -8 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 12 },
];
```

## Props Interface

Three-layer pattern — no Layer 1 `modes` prop; brand/theme/density come from the CSS cascade.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LAYER 2: Parent Component Props                      │
│ data, width, height, fullWidth                       │
│ chartHeader, chartFooter, chartLegend, dataDisplay   │
│ interactive, animated, accessibility                 │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                          ↓
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ LAYER 3: Child Component Configs                     │
│ chartHeaderConfig, chartLegendConfig                 │
│ dataDisplayConfig, histogramGroupConfig              │
│ chartFooterConfig                                    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop            | Type                  | Default | Description                                               |
| --------------- | --------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`          | `ChartDataPoint[]`    | `[]`    | Array of `{ category, value }` data points               |
| `width`         | `number \| string`    | `346`   | Total chart width                                         |
| `height`        | `number \| string`    | `400`   | Total chart height — HistogramGroup fills remaining space |
| `fullWidth`     | `boolean`             | `false` | Stretch chart to 100% of parent container width           |
| `chartHeader`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartHeader (title + subtitle)                     |
| `chartFooter`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartFooter (annotations)                          |
| `chartLegend`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Toggle ChartLegend                                        |
| `dataDisplay`   | `boolean`             | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay block above the histogram              |
| `interactive`   | `boolean`             | `true`  | Enable bar hover/click interactivity                      |
| `animated`      | `boolean`             | `false` | Staggered entry animation on first load                   |
| `accessibility` | `AccessibilityConfig` | `{}`    | ARIA wrapper, live region, hidden data table              |

### Layer 3: ChartHeader Config

| Prop                 | Type     | Default | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | —       | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | —       | Chart subtitle text |

### Layer 3: ChartLegend Config

| Prop                 | Type                           | Default    | Description                                |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------- | ------------------------------------------ |
| `items`              | `ChartLegendItem[]`            | —          | Manual legend items (overrides auto-gen)   |
| `categoryLabelValue` | `string`                       | —          | Single-series label (ignored if `items` set) |
| `type`               | `'circle' \| 'dashed' \| 'line'` | `'circle'` | Colour indicator shape                     |
| `dataHead`           | `boolean`                      | `false`    | Show DataHead block inside legend item     |
| `dataHeadConfig`     | `object`                       | `{}`       | DataHead props — `dataLeadValue`, `dataSupportingValue`, `supportingLabelValue` |

### Layer 3: HistogramGroup Config

| Prop                    | Type                                     | Default      | Description                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `yAxis`                 | `boolean`                                | `true`       | Y-axis with gridlines                                             |
| `xAxis`                 | `boolean`                                | `true`       | X-axis bin tick row                                               |
| `avgLine`               | `boolean`                                | `false`      | Average (or threshold) line                                       |
| `hoverBadge`            | `boolean`                                | `false`      | Cursor-following hover badge                                      |
| `valueFormat`           | `ValueFormatConfig`                      | —            | Format config — cascades to Y-axis, AvgLine, hover badge          |
| `color`                 | `string`                                 | —            | Custom bar colour (overrides `colorIndex`)                        |
| `colorIndex`            | `number` (1–12)                          | `1`          | Categorical palette slot — resolves `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` |
| `onBarHover`            | `(data: HistogramBarHoverData) => void`  | —            | Fired on bar hover enter/leave                                    |
| `onBarClick`            | `(data: HistogramBarHoverData) => void`  | —            | Fired on bar click                                                |
| `hoveredBarIndex`       | `number \| number[]`                     | —            | Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices`                     |
| `highlightedBarIndices` | `number[]`                               | —            | Indices at full opacity — all others dim                          |
| `dataSort`              | `'asc' \| 'desc' \| 'unsorted'`          | `'unsorted'` | Sort bars before render                                           |
| `yAxisConfig`           | `HistogramYAxisConfig`                   | `{}`         | `{ tickCount, formatValue, yAxisLabel, yAxisLabelValue, axisTickSkipper, skippedTicks }` |
| `xAxisConfig`           | `HistogramXAxisConfig`                   | `{}`         | `{ labels, tickCount }`                                           |
| `avgLineConfig`         | `HistogramAvgLineConfig`                 | `{}`         | `{ type, thresholdValue, formatValue }`                           |
| `hoverBadgeConfig`      | `HistogramHoverBadgeConfig`              | `{}`         | `{ formatValue, formatHoverBadge }`                               |

### Layer 3: ChartFooter Config

| Prop                   | Type     | Default | Description           |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------- |
| `annotationLeftValue`  | `string` | —       | Left annotation text  |
| `annotationRightValue` | `string` | —       | Right annotation text |

### Layer 3: DataDisplay Config

DataDisplayConfig mirrors `DataDisplayProps` and adds chart-specific hover-mode props.

#### Chart-specific

| Prop                    | Type                                        | Default    | Description                               |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `mode`                  | `'static' \| 'hover'`                       | `'static'` | Static values or hover-driven updates     |
| `formatHoverLeadValue`  | `(value, category?, index?) => string`      | —          | Custom formatter for lead value on hover  |
| `formatHoverBadgeValue` | `(value, category?, index?) => string`      | —          | Custom formatter for badge value on hover |

#### DataDisplay Layer 2 props

| Prop                       | Type                          | Default  | Description                                 |
| -------------------------- | ----------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `mainLabelValue`           | `string`                      | —        | Label text above the data value             |
| `type`                     | `'Left' \| 'Center'`          | `'Left'` | Layout — horizontal or vertical stacked     |
| `rightBadgeWrapper` | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle right/below supporting section       |
| `badgeTop`                 | `boolean`                     | `false`  | Toggle top badge slot                       |
| `badgeBottom`              | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle bottom badge slot                    |
| `showBadge`                | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle badge visibility                     |
| `supportingBadgeLabel`     | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Toggle label text next to badge             |
| `supportingBadgeLabelValue`     | `string`                      | —        | Label text next to badge                    |
| `size`                | `'XS' \| 'S' \| 'M' \| 'L' \| 'XL'` | `'L'` | Typography size variant              |
| `responsiveCollapse`       | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Collapse supporting section below threshold |
| `responsiveCollapseThreshold` | `number`                   | `440`    | Pixel width threshold for collapse          |
| `formatLabelText`          | `boolean`                     | `true`   | Auto-format label per Figma text rules      |
| `formatOptions`            | `FormatLabelOptions`          | —        | Options for label formatting                |

#### DataDisplay Layer 3 configs

**`dataHead`** (`DataHeadConfig`):

| Prop                  | Type               | Default | Description                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------ | ------- | ---------------------------------- |
| `dataLeadValue`       | `number \| string` | —       | Primary value                      |
| `dataSupportingValue` | `number \| string` | —       | Secondary value beside the lead    |
| `supportingData`      | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle supporting value            |
| `supportingLabel`     | `boolean`          | `false` | Toggle supporting label            |
| `supportingLabelValue` | `string`           | —       | Supporting label text              |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`| —       | Format config for lead value       |

**`badgeConfig`** (`BadgeConfig`):

| Prop           | Type                                       | Default      | Description                          |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------ | ------------------------------------ |
| `value`        | `number \| string`                         | —            | Badge value                          |
| `appearance`   | `ComponentAppearance`                      | `'primary'`  | Role-based colour                    |
| `autoDetect`   | `boolean`                                  | `false`      | Auto-detect positive/negative from value |
| `iconSlot`     | `'Icon' \| 'None'`                         | `'Icon'`     | Toggle badge icon                    |
| `valueFormat`  | `ValueFormatConfig`                        | —            | Format config for badge value        |

### Accessibility Config

| Prop        | Type               | Default  | Description                   |
| ----------- | ------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| `enabled`   | `boolean`          | `true`   | Enable accessibility features |
| `dataTable` | `boolean`          | `true`   | Include hidden data table     |
| `summary`   | `string \| 'auto'` | `'auto'` | Visually-hidden summary text  |
| `ariaLabel` | `string`           | —        | Custom `aria-label` override  |

## Usage Examples

### Basic

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={[
    { category: '0–10', value: 5 },
    { category: '10–20', value: 25 },
    { category: '20–30', value: 45 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Score Distribution',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Distribution of test scores',
  }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Internal data',
    annotationRightValue: 'Q4 2025',
  }}
/>
```

### Full-width

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  fullWidth
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Score Distribution' }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ hoverBadge: true }}
/>
```

### Currency format

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={revenueData}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    xAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'INR', abbreviate: true },
  }}
/>
```

### Threshold line

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  histogramGroupConfig={{
    avgLine: true,
    avgLineConfig: { type: 'threshold', thresholdValue: 30 },
  }}
/>
```

### Minimal (bars only)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  chartHeader={false}
  chartFooter={false}
  chartLegend={false}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true, xAxis: true }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (static KPI)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Total count',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '2,390',
      dataSupportingValue: '/ 3,000',
      supportingData: true,
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '+79.6%',
      appearance: 'positive',
    },
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (hover-driven)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a bin',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—' },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—', autoDetect: true },
  }}
  histogramGroupConfig={{ hoverBadge: false }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (hover + custom formatters)

```tsx
<HistogramChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `${value} responses`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value) => {
      const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
      return `${((value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    },
  }}
/>
```

## Height Behaviour

`height` controls the **total** container height. `HistogramGroup` fills all remaining vertical space after the other children.

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)     │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)             │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)             │  ← auto height
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                     │
│         HistogramGroup              │  ← flex: 1
│  (YAxis + bars + XAxis + AvgLine)   │
│                                     │
├─────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (optional)             │  ← auto height
└─────────────────────────────────────┘
         Total: height prop
```

`HistogramGroup` receives `height="100%"` and uses `ResizeObserver` to measure its actual pixel height for D3 scale computation.

## Animation

`animated={true}` enables a staggered grow-from-zero entry animation on first render. Each bar has an individual delay proportional to its index. Subsequent data-change transitions animate bar heights and AvgLine position smoothly. See **HistogramGroup.md** for the full entry settlement gate and token chains.

## Accessibility

`ChartAccessibility` wraps the entire chart and provides:

- `role="figure"` with `aria-label` and `aria-describedby`
- Visually-hidden natural-language summary
- Hidden `<table>` for screen reader navigation
- `aria-live="polite"` region for hover announcements

Announcements are debounced and include the bin label, value, and percentage of total:

> _"20–30, 25, 15.3% of total"_

When `dataDisplay={true}`, each bar gets `aria-controls` pointing to the DataDisplay element — assistive technology is informed that interacting with a bar updates that region.

See **HistogramGroup.md** → Accessibility for bar-level keyboard navigation, roving `tabindex`, and ARIA attributes.

## Migration from Old API

| Old                                  | New                           | Notes                                            |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `modes={{ fullWidth: true }}`        | `fullWidth={true}`            | Direct prop — no more `modes` object             |
| `modes={{ Platform, Density, ... }}` | Removed                       | CSS cascade — injected globally by Storybook / app |
| `dataBadgeSemantic`                  | `showBadge`                   | Renamed in `DataDisplayConfig`                   |
| `dataBadgeSemanticConfig`            | `badgeConfig`                 | Renamed; `dataBadgeSemanticValue` → `value`      |
| `avgLineConfig.dataBadge`            | Removed                       | AvgLine no longer has a DataBadge prop           |
| `colorIndex` description "(1-6)"     | `(1–12)`                      | Full 12-slot DataVis palette                     |
| `HistogramDataPoint[]`               | `ChartDataPoint[]`            | Use canonical format; `HistogramDataPoint` deprecated |
| `export default HistogramChart`      | `export function HistogramChart` | Named export                                   |
